'''Racer A2D-3''' was an [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that was used in the droid races on the [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] [[Promenade]] during the [[Grand Acquisitions Race]]. [[Sapaaga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] was a frequent better on the Promenade races.

==Behind the scenes==
Racer A2D-3 made his first appearance in the "The Great Acquisitions Race" World Event in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="The Grand Acquisitions Race" />
